description: This file defines a class 'UserMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. Its purpose is to configure a menu related to user management within the OrangeHRM system's admin module, specifically overriding the current screen to 'viewSystemUsers' when invoked.

classes.name: UserMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration functionality for user management in the admin module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewSystemUsers' using a helper method, and returns null.
